column1: # Claude Code plugins that must be installed on EVERY toolkit machine.
# One plugin per line, three TAB-separated fields:
#   plugin<TAB>marketplace<TAB>marketplace_source
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. `bin/ai-claude-plugins` adds the
# marketplace (when the machine does not know it yet) and installs
# `plugin@marketplace` at USER scope, so its skills appear in every project as
# `/<plugin>:<skill>`.
# A plugin reaches Claude Code ONLY. Codex, ZCode, MiMo and Antigravity never
# see its skills (#2791). A skill every client needs belongs under
# `skills/shared/`, and a helper program it calls belongs in the MCP catalog
# (`bin/setup-machine.ps1` on Windows, `bin/setup-secrets.sh` on Ubuntu).
# Additive only: deleting a line stops the install on new machines; machines
# that already have the plugin keep it (`claude plugin uninstall` removes it).
# Cost to weigh before adding a line: a plugin that ships an MCP server starts
# that server in EVERY Claude Code session on the machine (see
# plan_tool-and-skill-scoping.md, #707). Third-party plugins track their
# publisher's default branch; read the source before adding one here.
# Currently empty. ScaleDown's `slm-agent` was listed from 2026-11-18 (#2654)
# until 2026-11-23 (#2791), when the owner asked for its skills in every
# client. They are now the shared skills `slm-agent-evaluate` and
# `slm-agent-optimize`, and the helper they need is the catalog server
# `scaledown-migration-agent`. A machine that installed the plugin keeps both
# copies until `claude plugin uninstall slm-agent@scaledown` is run there.
